body:
sudo-queue/48 ran (nginx site + cert + deploy) but the site came up as a live 403: wotan-deploy.sh's rsync -a mirrors source repo perms, and this repo was 770/660 instead of OKEMILY's own 775/664 world-readable convention, so www-data couldn't read anything. Fixed repo perms to match OKEMILY (no sudo needed, fatbaby-owned repo), redeployed. Live-verified: wotan.okemily.com and /store.html both real 200s over HTTPS with correct redirect, /api/ proxy confirmed reaching live IDUNA. Commit 79fddbe.

⚓ ☃
title: WOTAN-DNS-001 fully live: fixed a real deploy permissions bug
